actions.name: ink cloud
actions.desc: Trigger: A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is &Reference[heavilyobscured] for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

actions.name: compression
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: water breathing
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: tentacles
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from all four tentacles.
